interface.shortDescription: Make, improve, and understand rolecards and software.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeave 1.8.0, 22 skills. Project-local progress and review boards show weighted implementation and acceptance separately, preserve ideas, bugs and review history, and project scope from total design with current evidence and handoff from NEXT. Review version-bound differences before synchronization. Optional frontend sandbox specifications, work libraries and plain language remain available. Board percentages do not replace real-host, driver or release gates.
